data.narrative: The student implemented an end-to-end integration and security test suite testing link creation, public redirects, auth protection (401), owner scoping/IDOR (403), URL bypass injection rejection (400), telemetry retention purging, and worker idempotency. They isolated database state with beforeEach cleanup and dynamic UUID fixtures, proving complete test determinism across 3 consecutive runs.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected integration-heavy testing over mock-heavy unit tests, correctly reasoning that mocks mask database constraint errors, serialization edge cases, and cache invalidation drift.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose integration-heavy test strategy to validate genuine database constraints, unique indexes, and HTTP request lifecycles against an isolated MongoDB instance.

dimension_scores.observation: Systematically diagnosed test flakiness stemming from shared index fixture keys and state leakage between test cases, resolving it through beforeEach collection wiping and dynamic UUID fixtures.
dimension_scores.evidence: Isolated flaky test failure caused by static request_id duplicate key errors; replaced with dynamic UUID fixtures and beforeEach collection wiping, achieving 3 consecutive passing test runs.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented automated regression tests verifying IDOR protection (403 Forbidden for non-owners), auth boundaries (401 Unauthorized for unauthenticated calls), and injection rejection (400 Bad Request for %3A%2F%2F and javascript:).
dimension_scores.evidence: Automated security tests in src/integration.spec.ts successfully verified that Principal B cannot read or delete Principal A's links, and that malicious URL schemes are rejected.

dimension_scores.observation: Guarded production database integrity by enforcing explicit NODE_ENV=test checks and dedicated test database connection strings to eliminate accidental data loss.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured isolated bootcamp_test MongoDB connection and verified automated database dropping in afterAll lifecycle hook.

dimension_scores.observation: Clearly articulated the critical risks of test state pollution, flakiness diagnostics, and production test database contamination.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented comprehensive test architecture, root causes of flakiness, and deterministic proof in progress/sdf/module-09-fix.md and progress/sdf/module-09-verification.md.

strengths: Authored a 16-test comprehensive suite covering core user journeys, IDOR security, and async worker idempotency.
Guaranteed test determinism by enforcing per-test collection clearing and isolated test database namespaces.
